CANDIDATE bd-01M16BVT725FRQ6AN5GNA3A01W: c1049f2 on m1/resolution, stacked on the importance candidate 8c09147 which is still blocked on the golden decision.

BUILT AS ARGUED. SignatureProjection returns SupportedScalar carrying the MINIMUM support among contributing components and the NAME of the component that set it. A weighted component with NO VALUE still refuses; a component with a value but thin support contributes and sets the floor if it is thinnest. Weighted components carrying no support notion at all are NAMED rather than ignored, so the minimum is not misread as covering them - "support 0.31, set by compression; 1 weighted component carries no support" rather than a bare 0.31.

MUTATIONS, three, each alone and reverted: P1 take the STRONGEST support instead of the weakest -> 1 FAILS. P2 hide the unsupported-component list -> 1 FAILS. P3 drop Missing components instead of refusing - the bead's option (a) - -> 2 FAIL.

P3 IS THE ONE I WANT ON THE RECORD, because it is the mutation that proves the split I argued for is load-bearing rather than pedantic. Under it the projection happily returns a number: a sum over whichever components happened to be measured, labelled with the same version and the same weights as a full projection. Nothing about the result says it is a different functional. Two signatures could be compared, both reporting v0, one of them silently missing a dimension. That is the drop-and-renormalize family again, and it would have been invisible in a green suite.

EVIDENCE at c1049f2, clean pin: alignJVM 176/176, alignJS 176/176, lawsJVM 81/81, interviewJVM 77/77, embedBench 52/52, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmt both green. fixturesJVM is NOT in that list and is still RED on the WOG golden, from 8c09147 below it - unchanged by this commit and still waiting on your decision at post-01M16FAM4VGEJ7R2V4GAQ3SQJT.

QUEUE STATE FROM ME: 8c09147 (importance, blocked on the golden) then c1049f2 (this). Neither is urgent. If you would rather I stop stacking behind a blocked commit and park the projection work on a branch off landed main instead, say so - I kept it stacked because the two touch the same file and rebasing one under the other later is the cheaper direction.
